title: Simple Skincare Routine for Working Women in India
ex: A five-minute skincare routine for busy working women in India: cleanse, moisturise and sunscreen in the morning, cleanse and night cream at night.
rt: Simple Skincare Routine for Working Women India | Mirc Glow
rd: A simple skincare routine for working women in India that takes about five minutes a day, with tips for office AC, commutes, late nights and a desk kit.
keyword: simple skincare routine for working women India
quick: A simple routine for working women takes about five minutes a day. In the morning, cleanse, moisturise and apply SPF 30 sunscreen. At night, take off makeup, wash your face and apply a pea-sized night cream. Add extras only on days you have time.
facts: Consistency matters more than the number of steps.
Sunscreen is needed even for indoor workers who commute by day.
Office AC can leave skin feeling dry.
Give a new routine 6–8 weeks before judging it.
